blurb: Self-hosted Actions runner → Fastlane → TestFlight, on a Mac you own
detail: Turns a Mac into an iOS build machine: self-hosted GitHub Actions runner, Unity batchmode export, fastlane match signing in a dedicated CI keychain, TestFlight upload. Interviews you first, then walks every secret click by click (budget about an hour for the secrets phase, half a day for the whole setup). Unlike per-minute services (Unity Cloud Build, Codemagic, hosted macOS runners) builds cost nothing after setup and keep a warm Library between runs, where cloud runners reimport from scratch, ~30 min per build. Ships a dated verification record, and the troubleshooting file is the part you will want at 2am: errSecInternalComponent, launchd PATH, Missing Compliance, all hit for real and fixed.
sections: runner-setup · secrets-setup · fastlane-reference · workflow-reference · troubleshooting · test-cases
notes: Verified against a live pipeline shipping TestFlight builds from a headless Apple Silicon Mac mini. Ends at TestFlight; needs the 99 USD/year Apple Developer membership and a Mac that stays awake. Does not cover CocoaPods projects (Firebase, most ad SDKs) yet.
